KaTeX 0.19.0, vendored from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and `fonts/` are unmodified distribution files.
The MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`. All resources are served locally;
conversation content is never sent to an external formula service.

To update, copy these same files from a pinned official package release, retain
the license, and run the web renderer, web channel, and math browser regressions.
